issues.description: The problem UML and description indicate the abstract Animal.messageOnFeed() method as public (UML shows '+ messageOnFeed(): String'), but the solution declares this method as protected (protected abstract String messageOnFeed()). This visibility difference is structural and could confuse students about the intended accessibility of the method.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the visibility between specification and implementation. Either update the UML/problem statement to allow protected visibility for messageOnFeed(), or change the implementation in Animal.java to 'public abstract String messageOnFeed();' so it matches the UML and makes the contract explicit to students.
